songs.title: Mo Anxiety
songs.verdict: Glitchy, Auto-Tuned internet rap that lives or dies on how much detail the production sneaks into the cracks.
songs.body:
Fourfive is an underground rapper building a fanbase through a steady run of singles and videos.
Mo Anxiety pairs glitchy production with melodic, Auto-Tuned vocals and arrived with an official video.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane. HotNewHipHop song post calls him an underground rapper, release Oct 23, 2026 (https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/1014493-mo-anxiety-fourfive); official video premiered same day. IG handle from the official video description. SoundCloud URL from a search result (page blocks fetching). Listener count unknown, check it.

songs.title: Pussc
songs.verdict: An Atlanta underground single that leads with melody and hook energy over bars.
songs.body:
Sk8star is an Atlanta underground rapper; his EP The Beautiful Rebellion came out in August 2026 and Peter Pusher followed in October.
Pussc puts his melodic side up front, backed by an official video directed by noahsocold.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane. HotNewHipHop (https://www.hotnewhiphop.com/1016410-pussc-sk8star) dates it Nov 12, 2026 and places him in the Atlanta underground; official video up Nov 11. artist_url is the smart link from the video description. Has a Lil Gotit feature and many videos: CHECK LISTENER COUNT, may be near/over 100k. IG not confirmed (X: 1sk8star).

songs.artist: doseone, Fatboi Sharif & steel tipped dove
songs.title: Truth Ugly
songs.verdict: An avant-rap summit of warped textures and heavily processed vocals that should be as jagged as the names on the cover promise.
songs.body:
A collaboration between Anticon veteran doseone, New Jersey rapper Fatboi Sharif and Brooklyn experimental producer steel tipped dove.
Truth Ugly goes for unpredictable, far-out abstract rap mixing poetry and politics.
songs.scout_note: Rap lane (abstract). Bandcamp Daily Best Hip-Hop October 2026 (https://daily.bandcamp.com/best-hip-hop/the-best-hip-hop-on-bandcamp-october-2026); Stereogum Oct 30, 2026. YouTube link is the official video for album track Vietnam Ghosts (premiered Oct 26). Independent (Fused Arrow / self-released). doseone is a cult veteran rather than a rising name, but all three are small. Exact release date ~late Oct, unconfirmed.

songs.title: Switch
songs.verdict: An independent comeback track from an EP pitched between alt-pop gloss and hyperpop jitter; the question is which side wins.
songs.body:
Yavin is an independent alt-pop artist back with his first EP in nearly seven years, after almost quitting music.
Switch is the featured track from the Underdog EP (Oct 16, 2026), a record about turning rejection into art.
songs.scout_note: Hyperpop-adjacent lane. Notion Magazine interview Oct 8, 2026 (https://notion.online/yavin-is-turning-rejection-into-art/) embeds this track under 'Listen to Switch'; EP out Oct 16. More alt-pop with hyperpop touches than core digicore. Independent; listener count unknown, check it.

songs.title: john dearly
songs.verdict: Fuzzy, hooky Brooklyn indie rock that should hit hardest if the hook earns the roundup buzz.
songs.body:
smush is a Brooklyn band fronted by vocalist and bassist Emily Borrowman.
The song is about feeling childlike in early adulthood and comes from the forthcoming album i'll always wish,,.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane. Our Culture '7 New Songs Out Today' roundup, Nov 2, 2026 (https://ourculturemag.com/7-new-songs-out-today-to-listen-to-yaeji-computerwife-and-more/). Small Brooklyn act; check listener count and label.

songs.title: Hammered
songs.verdict: Bedroom pop with a deliberately lopsided structure meant to mirror the singer's confusion.
songs.body:
Computerwife is the project of Addie Warncke, who wrote the song back in 2023.
It is the final single ahead of the album Born From a Wish, released in early November 2026.
songs.scout_note: Bedroom-pop lane. Our Culture roundup, Nov 2, 2026 (https://ourculturemag.com/7-new-songs-out-today-to-listen-to-yaeji-computerwife-and-more/), alongside bigger names, so check listener count and label.

songs.title: One Way Ticket
songs.verdict: Sunny, harmony-stacked indie pop reaching for a futuristic take on '70s radio warmth.
songs.body:
Sun Burnette is a Filipino-Mexican indie duo from San Diego: vocalist Anette and Marj on piano and synths.
The single goes for warm guitars and bright harmonies ahead of their EP Heaven is a Ruse.
songs.scout_note: Indie lane. Glamglare video post Nov 16, 2026 (https://www.glamglare.com/music/sun-burnette-one-way-ticket-video/); YouTube from the embed. Exact release date not stated (pre-EP single). No label mentioned, likely independent; check listeners.

songs.title: Body Right
songs.verdict: Sensual, folk-tinged R&B that aims for tenderness instead of heat.
songs.body:
Aaron is an independent R&B singer.
Body Right is about putting a partner first and previews his project All Feels, Vol. 2.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. EARMILK Oct 23, 2026 (https://earmilk.com/2026/10/23/aaron-dives-into-intimacy-on-sensual-yet-tender-rb-offering-body-right/); Spotify from the embed. EARMILK links IG aaronofficiaal (unconfirmed on an official page). One-word name, so double-check the artist profile and listeners.

songs.title: No Warning
songs.verdict: A late-night slow jam pairing '90s-style stacked harmonies with restrained, alternative-leaning production.
songs.body:
Cer2ified is a Memphis R&B duo, Dray Love and Alix J, recording out of Tacoma, Washington, on ONE FAMM MUSIC GROUP.
No Warning goes for light, bass-heavy grooves and stacked harmonies built for quiet listening.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. EARMILK Oct 6, 2026 (https://earmilk.com/2026/10/06/cer2ified-finds-the-sweet-spot-between-90s-rb-and-alternative-soul-on-no-warning/); Spotify from the embed (album: https://open.spotify.com/album/4LuNVDNPFe9Hwrc2yV8rZQ). Indie label, likely small; check listeners.

songs.title: GirlsLoveRnB
songs.verdict: A lush 15-track love letter to golden-era R&B that wants to feel nostalgic and current at once.
songs.body:
Terrence Esquire Huggins is a Latin Grammy-nominated producer stepping forward as an artist.
The album goes for sensual, slow-burn R&B about love and vulnerability, opening with a spoken-word piece.
songs.scout_note: R&B lane. EARMILK Oct 26, 2026 (https://earmilk.com/2026/10/26/terrence-esquire-huggins-dives-into-unspoken-emotions-on-girlslovernb/); Spotify from the embed. Exact release date not stated (~late Oct). EARMILK links IG esquiremusic1 (unconfirmed). Full album; focus track could be Rose Petals.

songs.title: HERE NOW
songs.verdict: Saxophone and cello run through electronics and beats, chasing a pop song that's atmospheric with an edge.
songs.body:
KatzPascale is the duo of saxophonist Sammi Katzmann and cellist-singer Jenna Pascale.
HERE NOW blends chamber instruments with electronic production; its B-side FRANK is a darker instrumental.
songs.scout_note: Left-field electronic lane. Glamglare Nov 17, 2026 (https://www.glamglare.com/music/katzpascale-here-now/); YouTube from the embed. Streaming link page: https://drop.cobrand.com/d/KatzPascale/herenow-frank. No label mentioned; check listeners.
